items.title: How does ATILA help reduce procurement cycle time?
items.description: ATILA automates approvals, three-way matching and document workflows, so requisitions to paid orders move in days instead of weeks — with full visibility at every step.

items.title: Is ATILA suitable for small and mid-sized businesses?
items.description: Yes. ATILA scales from SMBs to large enterprises, with configurable workflows, role-based access and pricing tiers that match your procurement maturity.

items.title: Can ATILA integrate with our existing ERP or accounting system?
items.description: ATILA offers API-based and file-based integrations with popular ERPs such as SAP and Oracle, plus inventory and accounting systems, keeping a single source of truth.

items.title: How secure is our data on the ATILA platform?
items.description: ATILA is built with bank-level security — encrypted data at rest and in transit, role-based access control, full audit trails and compliance-ready reporting.

items.title: How long does vendor onboarding take with ATILA?
items.description: With self-registration, automated validations and digital approvals, vendors can be onboarded and activated in a matter of days — with zero manual data entry.
